sn12.63:1.2: cattārome bhikkhave āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.63:1.4: kavaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā phasso dutiyo manosañcetanā tatiyā viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ.
sn12.63:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.63:2.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dve jāyapatikā parittaṃ sambalaṃ ādāya kantāra maggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ
sn12.63:2.4: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave dvinnaṃ jāyapatikānaṃ kantāragatānaṃ yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya
sn12.63:2.6: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave dvinnaṃ jāyapatikānaṃ evamassa
sn12.63:2.7: amhākaṃ kho yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhīṇā pariyādinnā
sn12.63:2.9: yannūna mayaṃ imaṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇ ḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā eva dvepi taṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyāma no ce sabbeva tayo vinassamhāti.
sn12.63:2.10: atha kho te bhikkhave dve jāyapatikā etaṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañca soṇḍikañca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā eva taṃ kantārāvasesaṃ nitthareyyuṃ
sn12.63:2.11: te puttamaṃsāni ceva khādeyyuṃ ure ca patipiṃseyyuṃ
sn12.63:3.2: api nu te davāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ madāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ maṇḍanāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyuṃ vibhūsanāya vā āhāraṃ āhareyyunti.
sn12.63:3.4: nanu te bhikkhave yāvadeva kantārassa nittharaṇatthāya āhāraṃ āhareyyunti.
sn12.63:3.6: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave kavaḷīkāro āhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:3.7: kavaḷīkāre bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte pañcakāmaguṇiko rāgo pariññāto hoti
sn12.63:3.8: pañcakāmaguṇike rāge pariññāte natthi taṃ saññojanaṃ yena saññojanena saññutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.63:4.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gāvī niccammā kuḍḍañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye kuḍḍa nissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ
sn12.63:4.3: rukkhañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye rukkhanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ
sn12.63:4.4: udakañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye udakanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ
sn12.63:4.5: ākāsañce nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye ākāsanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ
sn12.63:4.6: yaññadeva hi sā bhikkhave gāvī niccammā nissāya tiṭṭheyya ye taṃ nissitā taṃ nissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ
sn12.63:4.7: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave phassāhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:4.8: phasse bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte tisso vedanā pariññātā honti
sn12.63:4.9: tīsu vedanāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttarikaraṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn12.63:5.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ
sn12.63:5.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritu kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo
sn12.63:5.4: tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ.
sn12.63:5.5: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa ārakāvassa cetanā ārakāva patthanā ārakā paṇidhi
sn12.63:5.8: imañcāhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti
sn12.63:5.9: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave manosañcetanā hāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:5.10: manosañcetanāya bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte tisso taṇhā pariññātā honti
sn12.63:5.11: tīsu taṇhāsu pariññātāsu ariyasāvakassa natthi kiñci uttarikaraṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn12.63:6.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dassesuṃ
sn12.63:6.3: ayante deva coro āgucārī imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehīti
sn12.63:6.5: gacchatha bho imaṃ purisaṃ pubbaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti
sn12.63:6.11: gacchatha bho taṃ purisaṃ majjhantikasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti
sn12.63:6.17: gacchatha bho taṃ purisaṃ sāyaṇhasamayaṃ sattisatena hanathāti
sn12.63:6.20: api nu kho so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayethāti
sn12.63:6.21: etissāpi bhikkhave sattiyā haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayetha
sn12.63:6.22: ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehi haññamānoti
sn12.63:6.23: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave viññāṇāhāro daṭṭhabboti vadāmi.
sn12.63:6.24: viññāṇe bhikkhave āhāre pariññāte nāmarūpaṃ pariññātaṃ hoti nāmarūpe pariññāte ariya sāvakassa natthi kiñci uttarikaraṇīyanti vadāmīti.
